title: agastache cyprianii
intro: Agastache cyprianii, commonly known as Klamath sage, is a perennial plant species native to the southwestern United States. This plant has been used in traditional herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Klamath sage include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating wounds, skin conditions, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Klamath sage include essential oils, such as camphor, borneol, and bornyl acetate, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
